analysis.C1: every cell: upper end of the two-sided 95% interval of mean delta < M_c AND lower end of the two-sided 95% interval of mean fill difference > -0.01 (intersection-union)
analysis.C2: per shock cell: lower one-sided bound of mean(-delta) > M_c
analysis.C3: cell L: upper one-sided bound of mean waste-at-cost difference < -M_L AND lower one-sided bound of mean fill difference > -0.01
analysis.D4a_report: per cell beside C1: upper end of the 95% interval of mean delta <= 0 and fill floor -0.01
analysis.ablations: per component named at freeze C: no measured effect iff, in every cell, the two-sided 90% BCa interval of mean(J_without - J_SYNAPSE) lies inside (-M_c, M_c); never changes C1 to C3
analysis.degenerate: the interval is the value when every delta is equal
analysis.family: C2 (S1, S2, S3) and C3 by Holm at familywise one-sided 0.025: with h remaining, reject each whose one-sided BCa bound at 1 - 0.025/h clears its margin; repeat until none
analysis.generator: numpy Generator(PCG64(int(sha256('synapse/prereg-1/bootstrap/' || sig)[:8], big) >> 1)); cells drawn in the order N, L, S1, S2, S3
analysis.z0_ties: count bootstrap values equal to the estimate as one half

S3.orders_during: arrive at outage end plus lead time

cells.difference_in_differences: delta_S,k - delta_N,k per shock cell, with its interval (description)
cells.headroom: oracle told the shock, on validation seeds; mean advantage per shock cell published at freeze W (description)
cells.onset: uniform from the start of measured day 1 to the end of measured day 7 minus the duration; dedicated substream

comparison.common_random_numbers: every draw keyed by seed, purpose, item or supplier, and time slot, never by a policy's actions; replicate r of every cell uses seed_r
parity: same construction inputs in every cell: cell N declared parameters and exploratory-seed records
no policy receives cell identity or parameters, or calls the world's simulator, generator or random streams
any internal model is fitted only to the policy's own observation history and those inputs
a test asserts construction inputs byte-identical across the five cells
same decision points; one action: a whole-unit order quantity per item on the next scheduled delivery

observation: censored sales, on-hand by batch with expiry, open orders with placement times, receipts, realised lead times, time of day, day of week; never day index, horizon, cell or shock parameters

contest.arms: the freeze-C composition against the incumbent tuned on pooled shocks: of I1 and I2 so tuned, the lower mean J over the validation seeds of S1, S2 and S3 together
contest.seed: CONTEST-PROTOCOL.md, from a beacon round announced at least 72 h before launch
contest.statistic: mean daily paired cost difference, 95% moving-block bootstrap, block 7 days, 10000 resamples
contest.world: cell N with shocks as a Poisson process, rate one per 14 simulated days per type, parameters as S1 to S3

fixes: composition, its named components and its trust map, fitted on exploratory seeds only, with evaluation counts
C.late_rule: confirmatory time becomes 24 h after its push; R_C becomes the round at that time; deviation

fixes: world: every declared parameter, item set, suppliers and their items, lead times, delivery schedule, shelf lives, prices, initial state
censoring method and its masking check
incumbent tuned tables, evaluation counts and selection
D_c, p_c and M_c per cell
W.late_change: deviation; the confirmatory run is reported on both worlds, the frozen one primary
W.unfitted_parameters: each carries a cited source or is marked chosen with its reason
W.when: end of session 5, before any challenger or composition runs on the world

candidates.I1: order max(0, S - IP), IP = on hand + on order
candidates.I2: as I1, IP reduced by expected outdating: deplete on-hand batches oldest first by the mean demand up to each batch's expiry; units left at expiry are that batch's outdating

incumbent.guard_D4b: challenger quantity clipped to [0.5 q_I, 2 q_I]; q_I = 0 gives {0}; clipped share reported per cell
incumbent.order_up_to: S_{i,t} = ceil(k_{i,d} * mu_i(t)); mu_i(t) = mean demand over lead time plus time to the next delivery, per item, day of week and hour, from the tuning seeds
incumbent.selection: per cell, the version with the lowest mean J on that cell's 32 validation seeds; ties to I1

tuning.evaluation_unit: one simulated replicate at one seed
tuning.items: tuned together; each item's own J_i read from shared replicates; jointly if the world couples items
tuning.search: cyclic coordinate search over k_{i,d}, dayparts in clock order, from k = 1
tuning.stop: after an unchanged sweep at the smallest step; no cap short of convergence; evaluations and per-item convergence published at freeze W

margin.fill_rate: units filled over units demanded, all items pooled, over the 7 measured days
margin.source: declared world parameters, fixed at freeze W

objective.J_k: total over the 7 measured days divided by 7: money per store-day, in item-price units
objective.band_use: description only; re-prices the recorded L, W, H; decisions tuned at the primary values
objective.calibration_target: incumbent waste share of sales in cell N reported at freeze W against IFPA 2023 produce shrink 5.46%; any recalibration before freeze W

precedence: PREREG-1.md governs where the two differ

replicate.initial_state: per item, ceil(mean demand over nominal protection interval) on hand at age zero, nothing on order
replicate.warm_up: largest nominal shelf life plus largest nominal lead time, rounded up to whole days, never priced

replicates_per_cell.s_c: SD of the paired differences on the 32 validation seeds, fixed at freeze C

confirm.attempts: any execution reading R_C's signature is logged by a pushed commit before its output is opened; the first complete run is primary; a corrected run uses the same seeds and is reported beside it as a deviation; a defect is a failure of a test committed before freeze C, or a crash; a claim needs both runs
confirm.label: synapse/prereg-1/confirm/
confirm.replacement: only if no public relay serves R_C by 2026-12-12T00:00:00Z, then the first round served after service resumes; our own fetch or verification failure never replaces it
confirm.round_rule: round r is emitted at genesis_time + (r - 1) * period_s; the round at t is the first emitted at or after t
